title: Projective-space tilting equivalence and its derived-Hom inverse
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $n\geq0$. Let $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ for $S=A[x_0,\ldots,x_n]$, with twists as in [def-pc-projective-space-twist], and put $T=\bigoplus_{i=0}^n\mathcal O_X(-i)$ in cochain degree zero. Define $B=\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal O_X}(T)$, with multiplication given by composition, acting on $T$ on the left. There is an $A$-algebra identification of $B$ with the upper triangular $(n+1)\times(n+1)$ matrices whose $(i,j)$ entry is $S_{j-i}$ for $i\leq j$ and zero otherwise; here $S_d$ is the free $A$-module on the monomials of total degree $d$, and matrix multiplication uses polynomial multiplication. Write $D(\operatorname{Mod}\!\text{-}B)$ for the unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of right $B$-modules, and $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ for the derived category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category]. For a right $B$-module $L$, let $V(L)$ be the sheafification of $U\mapsto L\otimes_B T(U)$. The total left derived functor $LV=-\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}T$ exists on all of $D(\operatorname{Mod}\!\text{-}B)$ and induces an $A$-linear equivalence $$-\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}T:D(\operatorname{Mod}\!\text{-}B)\xrightarrow{\sim}D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X).$$ Its inverse is $R\operatorname{Hom}_X(T,-)$, the global derived Hom of [def-pc-global-derived-rhom], equipped with its right $B$-action by precomposition. In particular every $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ admits $M\in D(\operatorname{Mod}\!\text{-}B)$ and isomorphisms $M\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}T\simeq K$ and $\operatorname{Res}_A M\simeq R\operatorname{Hom}_X(T,K)$ in their respective derived categories.

proof.text: On each standard affine $U_k$, the twist bases make $T$ free of rank $n+1$ in degree zero, hence perfect. The standard cover has finitely many affine opens and affine overlaps (degree-zero localizations of the polynomial ring), so $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. The perfect-object compactness theorem gives compactness of $T$ in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. The finite-negative-twists generator lemma gives: $\operatorname{Hom}(T,K[q])=0$ for every $q$ implies $K=0$.

source.place: Tag 0A9V, lemma-generator-P1; Tag 09M1, proposition-compact-is-perfect; opening of the proof of Tag 0BQU.

proof.text: Twist multiplication identifies $\mathcal O_X(-j)^\vee=\mathcal O_X(j)$: on each $U_k$ the pairing of the two basis elements is $1$. Perfect duality therefore identifies $R\mathcal Hom(T,T)$ with the finite sum $\bigoplus_{i,j=0}^n\mathcal O_X(j-i)$ in degree zero. The monomial cohomology formula gives $H^q(X,\mathcal O_X(j-i))=0$ for $q\neq0$: for $n\geq1$ the only possible positive degree is $n$, where $j-i\geq-n$ rules out monomials with all $n+1$ exponents negative; for $n=0$ use the separate affine clause. Negative cohomology is zero for a sheaf in degree zero. Thus $\operatorname{Hom}(T,T[q])=0$ for $q\neq0$, using the cohomology identification for global derived Hom. In degree zero the $(i,j)$ component is $\operatorname{Hom}(\mathcal O_X(-j),\mathcal O_X(-i))=H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(j-i))=S_{j-i}$ for $i\leq j$, and zero otherwise. Locally these morphisms multiply sections, so composition has entries $(bc)_{ij}=\sum_k b_{ik}c_{kj}$ with polynomial multiplication. This proves precisely the claimed algebra and the left evaluation action; for $n=0$, $B=A$.

source.place: Equation 0CS9 (equation-algebra-for-Pn) and Tag 0BQU proof, self-Ext calculation; cohomology Tag 01XT.

proof.text: Apply the bundle-endomorphism derived adjunction to $E=T$: it constructs the total left derived functor of exactly the sheafified balanced tensor $V$, on the entire unbounded right-$B$ module derived category, with quasi-coherent image and $F(B)=T$. It also constructs the exact $A$-linear right adjoint $G$ with precomposition action and natural derived isomorphism $\operatorname{Res}_A G(K)\simeq R\operatorname{Hom}_X(T,K)$. Step 1 supplies compactness in the quasi-coherent category and step 2 supplies vanishing of every nonzero self-Ext, so the compact-bundle criterion makes $F$ fully faithful with invertible unit.

source.place: Tags 09LX and 09LY, derived tensor and Hom adjunction; Tag 09LZ, fully-faithful-in-compact-case; image in D_QCoh by perfect Tag 09M3.

proof.text: If $G(K)=0$, the adjunction cohomology formula gives $\operatorname{Hom}(T,K[q])=H^q(G(K))=0$ for every integer $q$. The generator lemma forces $K=0$. Thus the exact-adjoint zero-kernel criterion applies to $F\dashv G$ and proves that the unit and counit are natural isomorphisms. The $A$-linearity in step 3 makes this an $A$-linear equivalence. For any $K$, choose $M=G(K)$: the counit gives $M\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}T\simeq K$, and step 3 gives the required isomorphism $\operatorname{Res}_A M\simeq R\operatorname{Hom}_X(T,K)$.
